BareBoard (bareboard.org) is a free, non: BareBoard (bareboard.org) ke mohlodi wa thuto wa mahala, wo e sego wa kgwebo wo o neetšwego go nyakišišo ya tšhireletšo ya didirišwa tša go šoma ka thata, ditokomane tša boentšeneare bja go bušetša morago, le tsebo ya didirišwa tša go bulega. Diteng ka moka di phatlalatšwa ka mabaka a thuto le nyakišišo.
BareBoard exists so that anyone, anywher: BareBoard e gona gore mang le mang, kae goba kae, a kgone go ithuta kamoo didirišwa tša go šoma ka thata bophelong bja bona di šomago ka gona — mahala, ka mo go sa felego.
BareBoard is not a hacking collective, n: BareBoard ga se sehlopha sa go thuba, ga se lefelo la go dutla, ebile ga se tsela ye kopana go dikologa tšhireletšo ya motho le ge e le ofe. Ke panka, puku ya go ngwalela dintlha, le tafola ya go gatiša — ka tatelano yeo.
BareBoard is a general-audience educatio: BareBoard ke mohlodi wa thuto wa batheeletši ka kakaretšo. Ga re kgoboketše tshedimošo ya motho ka noši go bana ba ka fase ga mengwaga ye 13 ka go tseba.
BareBoard is not a collective for unauth: BareBoard ga se kopanelo ya phihlelelo ye e sa dumelelwago, ga se lefelo la go dutla, ebile ga se tsela ye kopana go dikologa tšhireletšo ya motho le ge e le ofe. Ke panka, puku ya go ngwalela dintlha, le tafola ya go gatiša — ka tatelano yeo.
BareBoard respects the intellectual prop: BareBoard e hlompha ditokelo tša thepa ya bohlale ya ba bangwe gomme e obamela Molao wa Tokelo ya ngwalollo ya Ngwagakete wa Dijithale (17 U.S.C. § 512). Re tla arabela ditsebišo tša go tšea fase tše di lego molaong gomme ra ba le moemedi yo a kgethilwego wa go di amogela.
BareBoard publishes original hardware re: BareBoard e phatlalatša dinyakišišo tša mathomo tša didirišwa tša go šoma ka thata — di-teardown, ditekanyo, go tšea diswantšho — bakeng sa batho bao ba ithutago didirišwa tša go šoma ka thata. Di- crawler tša tlwaetšo ya AI ga se batheetši ba rena, gomme ga re dumele go di fepa. Letlakala le le ngwala tšhireletšo ya legato yeo re e sepetšago: mellwane ye e tsebagaditšwego ya bao ba obamelago, le maraba a mafolofolo bakeng sa bašwahledi bao ba ba hlokomologago.
BareBoard is designed to minimize data c: BareBoard e reretšwe go fokotša kgoboketšo ya datha. Ga re nyake diakhaonto, ga re rekiše goba go abelana ka data ya motho ka noši — ka gobane ga re na yona go rekiša. Re šomiša Cloudflare Web Analytics go bala dipono tša letlakala; ga e beye dikhukhi ebile ga e latele baeti ka botee.
BareBoard ga e bee dikhukhi tša go latela. Ga go na dipuku tša papatšo tša motho wa boraro goba tša ditaba tša leago tšeo di laeditšwego.
BareBoard is an educational project. Eve: BareBoard ke projeke ya thuto. Se sengwe le se sengwe letlakaleng le ke mošomo wa rena ka noši go didirišwa tša rena tša go šoma ka thata — dinepe tša rena, dikelo tša rena, dilog tša rena tša go thoma. Ga re phatlalatše, ga re amogele goba ga re aba firmware, dinotlelo tša go hlatholla, diphasewete goba mangwalo a go hlatsela a mohuta ofe goba ofe. Maina a ditšweletšwa le maswao a kgwebo ke a beng ba tšona ka go latelana gomme di tšwelela mo fela go hlaola didirišwa tša go šoma tšeo di ngwalwago. Letlakala le ga le bope keletšo ya molao. Ge e ba o na le dipotšišo mabapi le seo se lego molaong nageng ya gago e itšego, boledišana le ramolao yo a nago le laesense. Ge o dumela gore selo se sengwe le se sengwe mo se gatakela ditokelo tša gago, ikgokaganye le rena thwii gomme re tla se rarolla ka pela.

🪞 240×320 262K-color single-chip TFT con: 🪞 240 × 320 262K-mala e le 'ngoe-chip TFT molaoli / mokhanni le foreime memoring ya (semmuso v1.6 doc mongolo ka CrystalFontz leqepheng la).
🪞 Dual-channel USB 2.0 Hi-Speed (480 Mbp: 🪞 Habeli-kanale USB 2.0 Hi-Lebelo (480 Mbps) ho UART / FIFO / MPSSE IC (semmuso FTDI doc v2.5, FT_000061).
🪞 240×320 262K-color a-Si TFT driver, 80: 🪞 240 × 320 262K-mala a-Si TFT mokhanni, 8080-letoto la lihlooho tse MCU / RGB / SPI (semmuso V1.05 doc; Ilitek ha e e phatlalatsa ka ilitek.com.tw).
🪞 DMOS microstepping driver with built-i: 🪞 DMOS microstepping mokhanni le hahiloeng-ka mofetoledi, ho fihlela ho 35V / ± 2A, feletseng-mohato ho 1/16-mohato (semmuso 4988-DS Rev. 6 ka seipone).
🪞 ESP-12E 802.11 b/g/n Wi-Fi module spec: 🪞 ESP-12E 802.11 b / g / n Wi-Fi modula spec v1.0 (4 MB halima, PCB eriele); e swaretšwego seiponeng sa morekiši, kgoro ya Ai-Thinker ka boyona ga e na kgokagano ya PDF ye e lebanyago.
🪞 Official NVIDIA whitepaper \"Tegra X1:: 🪞 Pampiri e tšhweu ya semmušo ya NVIDIA "Tegra X1: Superchip ye Mpsha ya Sellathekeng ya NVIDIA" (Jan 2015) ka mametletšo ya specs ya SoC. The feletseng Technical Reference Manual ke ngodiso-gated ka developer.nvidia.com — eseng sechaba.
🪞 262K-color single-chip TFT controller/: 🪞 262K-mmala e le 'ngoe-chip TFT molaoli / mokhanni (132 × 162), SPI + parallel (semmuso v2.1 doc ka Orient Pontšo; Sitronix ha ho letho setšeng sa eona).
🪞 Dot-matrix LCD controller/driver for a: 🪞 Dot-matrix LCD molaoli / mootledi bakeng sa dipontšho tša ditlhaka tša dialefabete le dinomoro (Rev 0.0, Sept 1999; seipone sa archive.org — sa mathomo ga se sa swarelwa).
🪞 Single-chip USB-ho-UART borokho, USB 2.0 lebelo le feletseng, ho fihlela ho 3 Mbaud, kopantswe EEPROM (semmuso FTDI doc v2.14, FT_000053). Ela hloko: ftdichip.com e bušetša HTTP 403 go di-fetch tše di itirišago; tsela ya bohwa e be e le http://www.ftdichip.com/Ditokomane/DataSheets/DS_FT232R.pdf.
🪞 Single-chip CMOS OLED/PLED driver+cont: 🪞 Single-chip CMOS OLED / PLED mokhanni + molaoli bakeng sa 128 × 64 letheba-matrix bontša (Rev 1.1, May 2014); ga go na khopi ya semmušo ya solomon-systech.com yeo e lego gona.
🪞 USB-to-serial UART chip, 50 bps–2 Mbps: 🪞 USB-ho-serial UART chip, 50 bps–2 Mbps (semmuso WCH CH340DS1 v2G koahela CH340G / C / T / R; hape akaretsa CH340C kristale-ka tlaase ho moo fapaneng).
